biggest_catch: You need two payroll direct deposits of $500 or more each within 100 days of joining, and the $300 bonus is paid to your Regular savings share up to 145 days after membership is established.
catches: Membership application must be started between 1/1/26 and 12/31/26, using promotional code 2026PROMO at the time of application.
Must be approved for and open at least one savings account and one checking account.
Set up and receive two (2) Qualifying Payroll Direct Deposits of $500 or more each into either the new savings or checking account within 100 calendar days of establishing membership.

Qualifying Payroll Direct Deposits are recurring electronic deposits from an employer, Social Security payments, and pension payments. P2P transfers, transfers between demand deposit accounts, and ACH/bank transfers not originating directly from an employer or the government do NOT qualify.
All requirements must be completed within the 100-day window; failure to do so disqualifies the promotion.
After the first 100 days, PSECU assesses eligibility; if eligible, the $300 bonus is deposited into the Regular savings share within up to 45 additional days (up to 145 days total).
Limited to U.S. citizens or permanent resident aliens residing in the U.S. who are 18 or older at the time membership is established.
Limit one $300 New Member Bonus per tax identification number. Joint owners are not eligible unless they open their own account.
Not eligible if you are a current PSECU member, closed an account within the past 12 months, or ever received any PSECU new member incentive bonus.
The fetched official pages do not state tax reporting for this bonus.
